BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO FROM KEP_PO WHERE PLANT = $PLANT$ AND LEGACY_PO_NO = $LEGACY_PO_NO$ AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ ) BEGIN INSERT INTO KEP_PO ( PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ITEM_NO, DS_DATE, AGENT_NAME, AGENT_TEL, IF_FLAG, IF_DATE, ORDER_FLAG )VALUES ( $PLANT$, $LEGACY_PO_NO$, $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$, $ITEM_NO$, $DS_DATE$, $AGENT_NAME$, $AGENT_TEL$, 'Y', $SYS_DATE$, $ORDER_FLAG$ ) END
ELSE BEGIN UPDATE KEP_PO SET DS_DATE = $DS_DATE$, AGENT_NAME=$AGENT_NAME$, AGENT_TEL=$AGENT_TEL$, ORDER_FLAG= $ORDER_FLAG$, IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = $SYS_DATE$ WHERE PLANT = $PLANT$ AND LEGACY_PO_NO = $LEGACY_PO_NO$ AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ END END
